evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' — moved straight into listing Einstein's features instead.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer raised no concerns in Section 2, so no follow-up opportunity existed.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provided: 'a typical move this size would normally take two movers one truck between six to eight hours since you're going to be moving a lot of that stuff yourself. I would estimate that the move would take between five and six hours. And I would look to budget between $950 and then 1140' — anchored to home size and personalized to customer's self-moving situation.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep said: 'if you would like to get on our books you may go ahead and respond to that email or you can just give us a callback as well' — softened with an easy out (email or callback), not a plain 'Would you like our help with your move?'

top_strength: Brianne gathered comprehensive logistics details (property types, square footage, room counts, special items, parking accessibility, box count) and delivered both service promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with clear terms in a natural, conversational flow.
coaching_note: Open Section 2 with the genuine agenda question ('Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?') before pivoting to Einstein's features — this is where you discover what the customer actually cares about, not where you list what Einstein has.
